speaker: Dr Wan Rizal
text: asked the Minister for Social and Family Development and Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs whether he can provide an update on MUIS’ efforts to strengthen the governance of the madrasahs in light of the recent developments relating to the police report made by Madrasah Irsyad.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development and Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: Allow me to briefly recap the events that occurred and the actions the Islamic Religious Council of Singapore (MUIS) has taken.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development and Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: Since the formation of the Joint Madrasah System in 2008, the role of Madrasah Irsyad’s Board of Governors (BOG) has been to set strategic direction and oversee the management for the Madrasah.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development and Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: MUIS oversees the appointment of the BOG members.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development and Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: The Madrasah Management Committee (MMC) continued to exist until 2016 to assist the madrasah in its fundraising efforts.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development and Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: Up until 2014, the madrasah carried out international projects that broadly promoted Islamic education and supported capacity building of Islamic schools in our region.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development and Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: In 2014, the MMC decided that the Madrasah should move its international projects to ITL, in order to focus its efforts and resources on strengthening management and improving education outcomes.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development and Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: Subsequently, MUIS' audits into the madrasah discovered questionable transactions and activities involving the use of the Madrasah's funds and resources for the activities of ITL.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development and Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: None of these transactions and activities were authorised by the BOG.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development and Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: Some of these transactions and activities may have resulted in the madrasah suffering financial losses.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development and Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: In April 2021, MUIS initiated a further audit on the madrasah to examine the financial transactions and relationship between the madrasah and ITL.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development and Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: Since then, MUIS has been assisting the Police in their investigations into this case, which resulted in the recent charges tendered in court against a Director of ITL.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development and Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: As the court case and civil claims are ongoing, I am not able to provide more information at this point.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development and Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: But MUIS will continue to monitor the developments to ensure that there is accountability to the madrasah and the community.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development and Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: In recent years, MUIS has put in place measures to strengthen governance across the madrasah sector.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development and Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: The importance of these measures has been reinforced by the problems discovered at Madrasah Irsyad.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development and Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: MUIS has established the Mosque-Madrasah-Wakaf Shared Services to support the madrasahs in their efforts to manage their finances better and prepare their accounts for audit.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development and Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: This shared financial service improves financial efficiency and governance across the madrasahs.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development and Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: Madrasahs are required to submit annual updates on their financial audits to MUIS and the BOG.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development and Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: This enables MUIS and the BOG to exercise financial oversight of the madrasahs, address gaps in a more timely manner and to identify and share lessons learnt on financial governance across the madrasah sector.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development and Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: MUIS requires staff rotation at the leadership level to be more frequent in the madrasahs.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development and Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: MUIS has introduced a whistleblowing procedure across the madrasah sector.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development and Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: This encourages a culture of active feedback from madrasah staff on situations or decisions made by the madrasah leaders.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development and Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: Where there is any suspected wrongdoing, this should be reported to MUIS or any relevant law enforcement agency.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development and Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: MUIS is also piloting the implementation of an IT and Data Policy Manual for the madrasah sector.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development and Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: This will strengthen the madrasahs’ data and information security policies and implementation.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development and Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: MUIS will continue to strengthen our madrasahs' efforts to deliver quality education and ensure good governance of the sector, so that we can build a strong cadre of asatizah who exemplify the three "C"s – Competency, Character and Citizenry – and provide religious guidance to our community to thrive as a Community of Success.

speaker: Dr Wan Rizal (Jalan Besar)
text: But I do have some questions about the timeline.

speaker: Dr Wan Rizal (Jalan Besar)
text: It started back in 2014 and it took some time before a report was made.

speaker: Dr Wan Rizal (Jalan Besar)
text: I was just wondering whether this timeline could have been shortened, given the new countermeasures in place?

speaker: Dr Wan Rizal (Jalan Besar)
text: And of course, I also worry about the IT and data capability that the Minister mentioned, that they are now implementing and working at.

speaker: Dr Wan Rizal (Jalan Besar)
text: Is there any way we can hasten this because the data is pretty important for us to ensure in the system?

speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
text: Whenever an irregularity has been detected internally or externally, MUIS would take action.

speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
text: Without the audit, we probably would not have discovered it.

speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
text: These regular checks that we have to do, even when what seemed to have been settled, must be carried on in any institutions so that we can continue to be accountable to the community.

speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
text: There is one more question that the Member asked about IT.

speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
text: As I mentioned just now, we do have to upgrade the IT capabilities as well as the governance around IT and data management in the madrasahs and that is a work in progress.
